dbspec.name: IETAlert
dbspec.source-query: SELECT ALERT_ID as "AlertID", RUN_DATE as "AlertDate", CUSTOMER_ID as "CustomerID", ACCOUNT_ID as "AccountID", CDD_RISK_LEVEL as "CDDRiskLevel", DISCLOSURE_COUNT as "DisclosureCount", EMPLOYMENT_STATUS as "EmploymentStatus", SOURCE_OF_FUNDS as "SourceOfFunds", PEP_FLAG as "PEPFlag", CUSTOMER_SEGMENT as "CustomerSegment", ORGUNIT_ID as "OrgunitID", ORGUNIT_CODE as "OrgunitCode", CUSTOMER_TYPE_DESC as "CustomerType", NATIONALITY_CODE as "NationalityCode", MONTHS_SINCE_INCORPORATED as "MonthsSinceIncorporated", MONTHS_SINCE_ACQUISITION as "MonthsSinceAcquisition", GENDER_CODE as "Gender", CUSTOMER_AGE as "CustomerAge", COUNTRY_OF_RESIDENCE as "CountryOfResidence", COUNTRY_OF_ORIGIN as "CountryOfOrigin", PREVIOUS_ALERT_COUNT as "PreviousAlertCount", ALERT_SCORE as "AlertScore", ALERT_FOR_EACH_TRANSACTION as "AlertForEachTransaction", ALERT_DAILY as "AlertDaily", ALERT_WEEKLY as "AlertWeekly", ALERT_MONTHLY as "AlertMonthly", ALERT_ACCOUNT as "AlertAccount", ALERT_CLIENT as "AlertClient" FROM V_SM_IETALERTS WHERE VALID_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY ALERT_ID
